Braum.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Braum's magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Seraphine has no escape ability, so Braum's stuns and knockups are dangerous; prioritize tenacity. If the enemy team has a lot of unavoidable crowd control, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Braum.combo: When Braum E Unbreakable is down or his shield faces away, charm him with Seraphine R Encore, then follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine Q High Note. If you hit Seraphine E Beat Drop on Seraphine P Stage Presence's echo cast, the first hit's slow turns the second hit into a root. Use Seraphine Q High Note once health has been reduced to make the most of its missing-health damage.
Braum.escape: The moment after you force Braum to use Braum W Stand Behind Me is your window to close the gap or catch Braum. Engage after Braum Q Winter's Bite or Braum R Glacial Fissure is down, and use Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore to stop follow-up engages. If Braum P Concussive Blows has marked you, use the movement speed from Seraphine W Surround Sound to retreat before more stacks build.
Braum.fight: Don't trade while facing Braum head-on. Poke from behind minions when he stops to last-hit. Immediately after Braum W Stand Behind Me is used, look for a chance to catch him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore. If Braum E Unbreakable is active, avoid the direction his shield faces and find an angle.
Braum.laning: Stay near your ADC to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes, and block Braum Q Winter's Bite with minions. Early on, don't spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound; save enough mana for Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound to answer Braum's engage.
Braum.phase: Early on, Seraphine should conserve mana and focus on spacing, blocking Braum Q Winter's Bite with minions. At any stage, standing in front makes it easy to get hit by Braum's follow-up crowd control, so position behind your allies.
Braum.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Seraphine W Surround Sound to grant a shield and movement speed, and answer Braum's engage with Seraphine E Beat Drop. Avoid the front of Braum E Unbreakable when finding an angle for your abilities, and just before your allies engage, extend Seraphine R Encore's range by firing it through your team toward the enemy backline. If an ally carry is caught, don't wait for a multi-hit angle; charm the diver with Seraphine R Encore.
Braum.watch: Braum Q Winter's Bite slows the first target hit and can start Braum P Concussive Blows' stacks, so stand behind minions. Projectiles cannot pass through the direction Braum E Unbreakable faces, so wait for the shield to drop or find an angle from the side.

Aphelios.fight: Trade when Aphelios has a weapon with low burst damage. Seraphine struggles to secure kills alone, so close the distance with an ally and catch Aphelios with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore when he isn’t holding Severum.
Aphelios.escape: Don’t close the distance when Aphelios can chain Gravitum’s slow into a root. If he isn’t holding Severum and has a weapon that makes it difficult to catch you, engage with an ally and use Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore.
Aphelios.build: Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Seraphine has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If a long fight makes Aphelios’s healing a problem, consider Grievous Wounds after building defenses.
Aphelios.combo: Before a fight, count Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo order so it lines up with Seraphine E Beat Drop. Hitting with echo E makes the first E’s slow turn the second E into a root. If Seraphine R Encore charms the target, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to keep them locked down, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note once health has been reduced.
Aphelios.laning: Stay by your marksman and build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes. Poke only when Aphelios stops to last-hit. Save Seraphine E Beat Drop to stop his engage.
Aphelios.phase: Early on, Seraphine struggles to secure kills alone, so watch Aphelios’s weapons and poke from a safe distance. Seraphine peaks in the mid-to-late game as her ability power builds, but her health and movement speed are low, so never stand in front at any stage.
Aphelios.teamfight: From the back line, give allies a shield and movement speed with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and spread out to avoid taking damage together from Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil. Just before your team engages, cast Seraphine R Encore through an allied champion to extend its range, then follow up on the charmed Aphelios with Seraphine E Beat Drop. If an allied damage dealer is caught, protect them immediately with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting for an angle to hit multiple enemies.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios’s Gravitum basic attack slows you, move out of range before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites roots you. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil explodes when it hits a champion and applies another attack from his main weapon to everyone hit, so spread out from allies when he can use it. Move away immediately when marked by Calibrum as well to avoid the follow-up attack.

Alistar.teamfight: From the back line, shield your allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound. When enemies group up, send Seraphine E Beat Drop through them to root them. Just before your team engages, cast Seraphine R Encore through your allies to reach enemies farther away. If an allied damage dealer is caught by Alistar, protect them with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting for a multi-hit angle.
Alistar.laning: Stay near your marksman and build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes. Don’t walk forward alone and give Alistar W Headbutt an opening. Poke only when the enemy stops to last-hit, and conserve mana early so you can use Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound when needed.
Alistar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Alistar’s main damage is magic, and Seraphine has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Get Mikael’s Blessing earlier if the enemy team has a lot of unavoidable crowd control.
Alistar.combo: Land Seraphine E Beat Drop on the echo cast from Seraphine P Stage Presence: the first hit’s slow turns the second hit into a root. If Seraphine R Encore charms the target, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to keep them locked down, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note once health has been reduced.
Alistar.escape: The moment after Alistar uses Alistar W Headbutt is your chance to approach or catch him. If Alistar Q Pulverize is also down, lock him down with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore, and use that time to push the wave or reposition.
Alistar.fight: Immediately after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are used, reset your distance and trade. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don’t commit your damage; back off and fight again when it ends. When you need to stop an engage, use the Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore you have saved.
Alistar.phase: Early on, getting caught by Alistar’s engage can make it easy to take follow-up hits, so manage your distance and mana. Seraphine should never stand in front at any stage.
Alistar.watch: Keep your distance first, since Alistar can follow Alistar W Headbutt with the knockup from Alistar Q Pulverize and the stun from Alistar E Trample. Near a turret, don’t give Alistar room to circle behind you and push Seraphine under it.

Draven.combo: Before trading, line up Seraphine's P Stage Presence echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop. If you hit Draven where his axe will land, the first E slows him and the second roots him. If Seraphine R Encore charms him, follow with E to root him, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after his health has been reduced.
Draven.build: Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first because Draven’s main damage is physical, but also watch your total health so you can survive the execute from Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.escape: Close the distance with an ally after Draven E Stand Aside is down. Draven has no ability to create distance on his own, so look for a chance to lock him down with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore. Since Draven W Blood Rush increases his movement speed, aim your crowd control where an axe will land.
Draven.fight: Trade when Draven has only one Draven Q Spinning Axe left or has dropped them all. Fire Seraphine E Beat Drop where an axe will land: if Draven catches it, he gets hit; if he dodges, he loses the axe. When engaging, use Seraphine W Surround Sound to give allies both movement speed and a shield.
Draven.laning: When Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes early, farm safely and don’t give up a kill. Stay near your marksman and use Seraphine P Stage Presence notes. Poke only when Draven stops to last-hit. Don’t waste mana by spamming Q and W; work with your allied jungler to catch Draven when he steps forward.
Draven.phase: Early on, Draven’s basic attacks with an axe are strong, so focus on not giving up a kill. After laning, catch Draven with your team when he’s alone to reduce the lead he built early.
Draven.teamfight: From the back line, shield your allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound. Send Seraphine E Beat Drop through where Draven’s axes will land and through grouped enemies. Just before your team engages, cast Seraphine R Encore through an allied champion to extend its range and find an angle that reaches Draven. If an allied damage dealer is caught, don’t wait for a multi-hit angle; charm the enemy who engaged with R and send them back.
Draven.watch: Avoid trading early while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes. Keep your distance to avoid the displacement and slow from Draven E Stand Aside. Even after dodging Draven R Whirling Death once, move completely out of both its outward and return paths.

Karma.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Karma's main source of magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and prioritize magic resistance.
Karma.combo: Line up Seraphine P Stage Presence's echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop: the first E's slow lets the second E root Karma. If Seraphine R Encore charms Karma, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root her, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after her health has been reduced.
Karma.escape: When Karma W Focused Resolve is down, you have a chance to close the gap. If Karma E Inspire's shield, empowered by Karma R Mantra, is active, wait for it to expire, then catch her with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
Karma.fight: Trade briefly only when Karma stops to last-hit. Bait out Karma W Focused Resolve and wait until the shield from Karma E Inspire, empowered by Karma R Mantra, has expired before going in. Don't waste Seraphine E Beat Drop on poke; save it to respond if Karma approaches.
Karma.laning: Build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes beside your ranged carry and use the increased basic attack range. Don't use Seraphine Q High Note and Seraphine W Surround Sound too freely early; save mana for when you need them. Position with Karma's poke range and the tether range of Karma W Focused Resolve in mind.
Karma.teamfight: Stay behind your team and use Seraphine W Surround Sound to shield allies and grant them movement speed. Engage after the shield from Karma E Inspire, empowered by Karma R Mantra, expires. Fire Seraphine E Beat Drop through grouped enemies, and extend Seraphine R Encore's range by aiming through your allied formation. If an allied damage dealer is caught, protect them with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting for an angle to hit multiple enemies.
Karma.watch: When empowered by Karma R Mantra, Karma Q Inner Flame explodes at the spot it hits, so move outside the circle immediately. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance before it roots you. Be extra careful with W empowered by Karma R Mantra, as it heals Karma while connected. If you keep getting hit by Karma's abilities, she can use Karma R Mantra more often, so manage your range and positioning.
Karma.phase: Early on, manage Seraphine's mana consumption and focus on keeping your distance. The supplied information alone is insufficient to determine which champion has the advantage over the other at each stage of the game.

KogMaw.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against Kog'Maw's main ability damage, but account for his physical damage from basic attacks too. Avoid fighting while your resistances are reduced after being hit by Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle.
KogMaw.combo: Line up Seraphine P Stage Presence's echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop: the first hit's slow lets the second hit root Kog'Maw. If Seraphine R Encore charms him, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root him, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after his health has been reduced.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility, so engage when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends. If you dodge the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, close the gap with your allies and catch him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
KogMaw.fight: Close the gap with your allies after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends. Kog'Maw has no mobility, so slow him first, then root him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or catch him with the charm from Seraphine R Encore to engage. Trade when he stops to last-hit.
KogMaw.laning: Build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes beside your ranged carry to make use of the extra range and basic attack damage. Don't overextend to poke while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active; pressure his farming after it ends. Save mana early so Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound are available when needed.
KogMaw.teamfight: Stay behind your allies and use Seraphine W Surround Sound to shield them and grant movement speed. When Kog'Maw is grouped with enemies, root them with Seraphine E Beat Drop. Fire Seraphine R Encore through allies in front to extend its range and reach Kog'Maw. If an allied damage dealer is caught, charm the enemy who engaged with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting for a multi-hit angle.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, his range and basic attack damage increase, so keep your distance until it ends. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle lowers armor and magic resistance, so block it behind minions or dodge to the side. If it hits you, don't engage right away.
KogMaw.phase: Early on, Seraphine should disrupt Kog'Maw's farming with her allies rather than try to get kills alone. Kog'Maw becomes strong late, but Seraphine is also strong in the mid to late game as her ability power builds, so stay behind your allies and help in teamfights.

Leona.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to prioritize magic resistance, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Also consider what type of damage the enemy carry deals while Leona has someone caught when choosing your next resistance item. If the enemy team has a lot of unavoidable crowd control, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Leona.combo: When Leona E Zenith Blade is down, charm her with Seraphine R Encore, then follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine Q High Note, in that order. Before the fight, line up Seraphine P Stage Presence's echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first hit's slow leads into a root from the second.
Leona.escape: Right after Leona E Zenith Blade is down, Seraphine has a window to close the gap and counterattack. Don't go in first if Leona still has another way to catch you. If she dashes in, respond with Seraphine E Beat Drop and retreat using the shield and movement speed from Seraphine W Surround Sound.
Leona.fight: Keep your distance while Leona E Zenith Blade is available, and save Seraphine E Beat Drop to respond to her dash. As soon as Leona E Zenith Blade is down, lock her down with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore and counterattack. When Leona W Eclipse is active, move outside its area before it explodes.
Leona.laning: Build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes beside your ranged carry, but don't stand in a line where Leona E Zenith Blade can pierce both of you. Poke from range only when the enemy stops to last-hit, and save mana early so Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound are available.
Leona.teamfight: Stay behind your team and use Seraphine W Surround Sound to protect them. If enemies group up, root them by firing Seraphine E Beat Drop through them. Fire Seraphine R Encore through allies in front to extend its range and target the enemy backline. If Leona catches an allied damage dealer, use Seraphine R Encore immediately to defend them, and retreat if a Leona P Sunlight mark is applied.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and dashes her to the last champion hit, so don't stand in a line with your allies. Leona can activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so watch your distance instead of whether she has used the ability. When the indicator for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move to the side to avoid the stun at its center.
Leona.phase: Early on, Seraphine should poke from behind while respecting Leona's high armor and strong engage. At every stage, avoid standing in front and giving Leona the distance she needs to engage.

Lulu.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance since Lulu's damage and most of the damage Seraphine takes are magic damage.
Lulu.combo: If you have a chance to catch Lulu, charm her with Seraphine R Encore, root her with Seraphine E Beat Drop, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after her health has been reduced. Line up Seraphine P Stage Presence's echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first hit's slow lets the second hit root her.
Lulu.escape: Close the gap after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally. If Lulu R Wild Growth has also been used, she has lost her tools to save her target or knock up nearby enemies, so follow up on Lulu herself with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore.
Lulu.fight: Poke briefly only when Lulu and her lane partner stop to last-hit. If Lulu W Whimsy has been used on another ally and the shield from Lulu E Help, Pix! is on an allied carry, you have a chance to hit Lulu herself with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore.
Lulu.laning: Position behind minions beside your ranged carry to reduce the extra damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion. Use the notes from Seraphine P Stage Presence to poke steadily, but save mana early so Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound are available when needed.
Lulu.phase: Early on, Seraphine needs to manage her distance and mana while watching out for Lulu's slow and silence. Never stand in front at any stage of the game.
Lulu.teamfight: Stay behind your team and use Seraphine W Surround Sound to protect them. Fire Seraphine E Beat Drop through grouped enemies. Fire Seraphine R Encore through allies in front to extend its range and reach the enemy backline. If an allied damage dealer is caught, charm the enemy who engaged with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting for an angle to hit multiple enemies.
Lulu.watch: If Lulu Q Glitterlance slows you and Lulu W Whimsy silences you, Seraphine has no ability to escape and will struggle to avoid the follow-up attacks. Keep your distance, and don't move close just because an ally has caught a target while Lulu R Wild Growth is available.

Lux.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to help you survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lux deals mostly magic damage, and Seraphine has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, charm her with Seraphine R Encore, then follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine Q High Note, in that order. While the charm makes Lux walk toward you, root her with E; use Q after her health has been reduced to make use of its damage based on missing health. If you use E without R, line it up with your echo so the first E's slow leads into a root from the second.
Lux.escape: Right after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to engage. Lux has no ability to create distance, so close the gap and catch her with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
Lux.fight: Bait out Lux Q Light Binding and dodge it, then close the gap to fight. Trade when Lux stops to last-hit, and use Seraphine W Surround Sound to move with your allies out of Lux E Lucent Singularity's area.
Lux.laning: Stay close to your ranged carry to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes, but don't stand in a line with an ally, since Lux Q Light Binding can hit both of you. Don't use Seraphine Q High Note and Seraphine W Surround Sound too freely to poke early; save mana for when you need them.
Lux.teamfight: Stay behind your team and use Seraphine W Surround Sound to protect them. Spread out as you approach so Lux E Lucent Singularity can't catch you together. If you have an angle to extend Seraphine R Encore through an ally to reach Lux's backline, use it just before your ally engages, then root them with Seraphine E Beat Drop. If an allied damage dealer is caught, charm the enemy who engaged with R instead of waiting to hit multiple enemies.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits, she can follow up with more abilities, so sidestep when she casts Q and don't stand in a line with your allies. Use the movement speed from Seraphine W Surround Sound to escape Lux E Lucent Singularity's area. If you are hit by a Lux ability, create distance so you don't take a basic attack that triggers Lux's Illumination mark. Sidestep when the aim line for Lux R Final Spark appears.
Lux.phase: Early on, being caught by Lux Q Light Binding makes it easy to take follow-up damage, so hold out and trade cautiously. Seraphine should never stand in front at any stage.

Maokai.build: Prioritize magic resistance early with Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Choose your next resistance item based on the enemy carry who deals damage while Maokai has someone caught.
Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, if you charm him with Seraphine R Encore, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root him and Seraphine Q High Note to finish him.
Maokai.escape: Right after you bait Maokai W Twisted Advance is your window to close the gap and engage.
Maokai.fight: After Maokai uses W, step forward to trade, but wait until his dash ends and he lands before using your abilities. Use Seraphine Q High Note to finish off an enemy who has lost health.
Maokai.laning: Stay close to your ranged carry to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes, and don't go forward alone to poke. Focus ability poke on the enemy carry rather than Maokai so you don't trigger Maokai P Sap Magic's healing too often. Save mana early so Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound are available.
Maokai.phase: Early on, manage your distance and mana while watching out for the root from Maokai W Twisted Advance. Seraphine should never stand in front to take Maokai's engage at any stage of the game.
Maokai.teamfight: Stay behind your team and use Seraphine W Surround Sound to shield allies and grant them movement speed. If enemies group up, root them by firing E Beat Drop through them. Fire Seraphine R Encore through allies lined up in front to extend its range. If Maokai engages on an allied damage dealer, send him back with R by charming him instead of waiting for a multi-hit angle.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance dashes in and roots Seraphine, so don't approach the brush while it's available. Maokai E Sapling Toss from a brush has a larger explosion, so be careful when entering, and if a sapling follows you, lead it toward minions instead of your allies. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from far away, move perpendicular to its direction.

Bard.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle to survive early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Bard deals mostly magic damage, and Seraphine has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Get Mikael’s Blessing earlier if the enemy team has a lot of unavoidable crowd control.
Bard.combo: Before a fight, line up Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo order with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first E’s slow turns the second E into a root. If Seraphine R Encore charms the target, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to keep them locked down, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note once health has been reduced.
Bard.escape: The moment after you force Bard to use Bard E Magical Journey is your chance to close the distance. Find a position where you can avoid the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then use Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore during that window. Follow a portal used to escape only if you judge it safe.
Bard.fight: Conserve mana early and trade only when Bard or an ally stops to last-hit. Once Bard E Magical Journey is down, look for an angle to lock him down with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore, then use Seraphine Q High Note on Bard after he has lost health.
Bard.laning: Stay near your marksman and use Seraphine P Stage Presence notes to improve your basic attack range and damage. If you see Bard W Caretaker’s Shrine, walk over it to remove it.
Bard.phase: Early on, it’s important to conserve Seraphine’s mana and play to avoid the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding. The available information isn’t enough to determine which champion has the advantage at each stage.
Bard.teamfight: From the back line, give allies a shield and movement speed with Seraphine W Surround Sound. Send Seraphine E Beat Drop through grouped enemies. Just before your team engages, cast Seraphine R Encore through an ally to extend its range and reach the enemy back line. If an allied damage dealer is caught, charm the enemy who engaged with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting for an angle to hit multiple enemies.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns when it hits a wall or a second target, so don’t stand with a wall behind you or in a line with an ally or minion. Bard E Magical Journey can let him enter from the flank, so don’t leave that route open. Keep in mind that targets hit by Bard R Tempered Fate become immune to damage.

Blitzcrank.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to defend against Blitzcrank’s main damage from Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field.
Blitzcrank.combo: Before a fight, line up Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo order with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first E’s slow turns the second E into a root. If Seraphine R Encore charms the target, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to keep them locked down, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note once health has been reduced.
Blitzcrank.escape: You have an opportunity to move forward when Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or he’s low on mana. At that point, Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you get an angle to engage, catch him with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade just after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when Blitzcrank is low on mana. Don’t walk forward while Blitzcrank can still catch you. When you engage, be ready to lock him down with Seraphine E Beat Drop.
Blitzcrank.laning: Stand behind minions so Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab hits a minion first, and build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes near your marksman. Secure vision in bushes. Don’t spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound early; save mana for when you need it.
Blitzcrank.phase: Early on, getting caught by Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab can make it easy to take follow-up hits, so focus on managing your distance. Seraphine’s health and movement speed are low, so she must never stand in front at any stage.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: From the back line, shield your allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound. Send Seraphine E Beat Drop through grouped enemies to root them. Cast Seraphine R Encore in the direction your allies are lined up to extend its range and reach the enemy back line. If an allied damage dealer is caught, charm the enemy who engaged with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting for a multi-hit angle.
Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, he can follow with the knockup from Blitzcrank E Power Fist and the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field. Seraphine has no escape ability, so stand behind minions and keep away from bushes when you lack vision of them.

Brand.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle to survive early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Brand deals mostly magic damage, and Seraphine has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Get Mikael’s Blessing earlier if the enemy team has a lot of unavoidable crowd control.
Brand.combo: Charm Brand with Seraphine R Encore, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to keep him locked down, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note. Before a fight, line up Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo order with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first hit’s slow makes the second hit root. If your allies are lined up in front, fire Seraphine R Encore through them to extend its range.
Brand.escape: Close the distance with an ally the moment Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. If you aren’t ablaze, Brand Q Sear can’t stun you, but if you are ablaze, dodge the projectile before moving in. Brand has no mobility spell, so once you close the distance, catch him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
Brand.fight: Trade only when Brand stops to last-hit, and look for a chance to engage with an ally once Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. Don’t waste Seraphine E Beat Drop on poke; save it to lock him down then. Use Seraphine Q High Note after Brand has lost health to get more value from its damage.
Brand.laning: Don’t last-hit beside burning minions; if the wave is grouped together, move to the side. Stay near your marksman to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes, and don’t walk forward alone to poke. Don’t spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound early; save mana to use Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound when needed.
Brand.phase: Early on, account for Seraphine’s mana costs and low magic resistance: avoid risky poke and focus on surviving first. Never stand in front at any stage; fight from behind your allies.
Brand.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from allies to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing. Don’t stand beside an ally who is ablaze. Use Seraphine W Surround Sound when starting an engage or retreat to make use of its shield and movement speed, and send Seraphine E Beat Drop through grouped enemies. Just before your team engages, cast Seraphine R Encore through your allies to extend its range, but if an allied damage dealer is caught, protect them immediately with the charm.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when you’re hit by abilities in quick succession, then explodes, so dodge his first ability, especially Brand Q Sear and Brand W Pillar of Flame. If you’re ablaze, move out of Brand Q Sear’s projectile path or stand behind a minion to avoid its stun. Brand E Conflagration can spread from burning minions, so stand away from them. Spread out from allies when you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast.

Caitlyn.build: Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Caitlyn’s main damage is physical, and Seraphine has low armor, so build armor first.
Caitlyn.combo: Before a fight, line up Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo order with Seraphine E Beat Drop. If the first hit of echo E slows, the second hit roots. If Seraphine R Encore charms the target first, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to keep them locked down, then use Seraphine Q High Note once health has been reduced.
Caitlyn.fight: Trade just after Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to clear the wave, when she stops to last-hit. Use Seraphine W Surround Sound as you start the trade to benefit from its shield and movement speed.
Caitlyn.laning: While Caitlyn is strong early, don’t risk giving up a kill; farm under your turret. Stay near your marksman to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes, and don’t walk forward alone to poke. Don’t spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound early; save mana for when you need it.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong in the early laning phase, so play safely and farm. In the mid-to-late game, as your ability power builds, fight from behind your allies.
Caitlyn.teamfight: From the back line, shield your allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound. Send Seraphine E Beat Drop through grouped enemies. Just before your team engages, cast Seraphine R Encore through your allies to extend its range. If an allied damage dealer is caught, immediately charm the enemy who engaged with Seraphine R Encore.
Caitlyn.watch: Take Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker from behind an allied minion so you only take its reduced damage after the first target. Avoid Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap in bushes and narrow paths. If a trap roots you, Caitlyn P Headshot can deal heavy damage from its increased range.

Ezreal.build: Get movement speed first to dodge Ezreal's long-range poke and close the gap. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so don't focus your resistances on just one type.
Ezreal.combo: Once Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, charm him with Seraphine R Encore, root him with Seraphine E Beat Drop, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note. If Seraphine P Stage Presence is on its echo cast, hit with Seraphine E Beat Drop twice to carry the first hit's slow into a root on the second hit.
Ezreal.escape: The moment after you make Ezreal use E Arcane Shift is your chance to go in. Ezreal has no crowd control, so catch him then with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore, but don't let him keep hitting Ezreal Q Mystic Shot and getting his mobility spell back sooner.
Ezreal.fight: Trade briefly only when Ezreal stops to last-hit, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced. Before committing to an engage, first force Ezreal to use E Arcane Shift, and use the movement speed from Seraphine W Surround Sound to close the gap with your allies.
Ezreal.laning: Move with minions between you and Ezreal to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. Stay near your ADC to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes, and early on, don't spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound so you have mana when you need it.
Ezreal.phase: Early on, Seraphine should conserve mana and play safely behind minions. Don't trade poke with Ezreal in open areas.
Ezreal.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Seraphine W Surround Sound for a shield and movement speed, and catch Ezreal with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore after Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down. You can extend Seraphine R Encore's range by firing it through an ally in front, and if an ally carry is caught, protect them immediately with the charm.
Ezreal.watch: Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot from behind minions, and remember that repeatedly getting hit also speeds up Ezreal E Arcane Shift's cooldown. If Ezreal W Essence Flux hits you, use Seraphine W Surround Sound for a shield and movement speed to briefly get out of range. When retreating at low health, change your angle to avoid the straight path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.

Heimerdinger.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Heimerdinger's turrets, rockets, and grenades all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance. If the enemy team has a lot of unavoidable crowd control, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Heimerdinger.combo: Charm with Seraphine R Encore, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root, then use Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced. If your ultimate is unavailable, time Seraphine P Stage Presence's echo cast with E. The first E's slow turns the second E into a root, preventing Heimerdinger from escaping.
Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no ability to create distance on his own, so go around his turret setup, close the gap, and catch him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
Heimerdinger.fight: Catch them with Seraphine E Beat Drop, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced.
Heimerdinger.laning: Stay near your ADC to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes, and don't walk alone in front of Heimerdinger's turret setup. Trade only when the opponent stops to last-hit; otherwise, save mana for Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound. If you can push Heimerdinger back, don't waste time destroying his turrets one by one.
Heimerdinger.phase: Early on, watch out for Heimerdinger's turret setup and grenades while managing your spacing and mana. In the mid and late game, as your ability power builds, use Seraphine's shields and crowd control from behind your allies.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Seraphine W Surround Sound when an engage or retreat begins to provide a shield and movement speed. Don't clump together and run straight into Heimerdinger's turrets. When your allies engage, fire Seraphine R Encore through your team to extend its range, then follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop. If an ally carry is caught, protect them with R's charm instead of waiting for a multi-hit angle.
Heimerdinger.watch: If you get hit, use Seraphine W Surround Sound for a shield and movement speed, then move out of turret range.

Hwei.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei's main damage is magic, and Seraphine has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't rely on stacking health alone.
Hwei.combo: Charm with Seraphine R Encore, root with E Beat Drop, then finish with Q High Note after health has been reduced. If using R Encore is difficult, time E Beat Drop with Seraphine P Stage Presence's echo cast to carry the first shot's slow into a root on the second. If you throw E Beat Drop first without setting it up, it only slows, so look for an opening when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability to create distance on his own, so the moment after he uses Hwei E Subject: Torment is your chance to engage. Approach with your allies then and catch him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or R Encore. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, don't lead the engage.
Hwei.fight: Trade only when Hwei stops to last-hit. If Hwei E Subject: Torment has just been used to poke or clear the wave, close the gap with your allies and catch him with Seraphine E Beat Drop and R Encore. Seraphine has a hard time getting kills alone and is fragile, so don't get ahead of your allies.
Hwei.laning: Stay near your ADC to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes and make the most of the attack range and damage. Early on, don't spam Seraphine Q High Note or W Surround Sound; poke only when Hwei stops to last-hit. Watch for the eye left by Hwei E Subject: Torment's Gaze of the Abyss, and reposition immediately if his first ability hits you.
Hwei.phase: Early on, Seraphine can poke but has a hard time getting kills alone, so conserve mana and lane near your allies. Seraphine peaks in the mid and late game as her ability power builds, but never stand in front at any stage.
Hwei.teamfight: From the backline, use Seraphine W Surround Sound to give allies a shield and movement speed. If possible, time Seraphine P Stage Presence's echo with W Surround Sound to also heal them. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down and the enemy team is grouped, hit them with a penetrating Seraphine E Beat Drop to root them. Fire Seraphine R Encore through your team just before they engage, or use it immediately to protect an ally carry if they're caught.
Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or pulls you in, you're likely to take the follow-up damage too, so don't step forward while that ability is available. If Hwei's first ability hits you, move immediately to avoid his second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Also watch for passages covered by the lava pool from Hwei Q Subject: Disaster and the eye left by Hwei E Subject: Torment's Gaze of the Abyss, and take a route around them.

Janna.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Janna's damage is mainly magic, so if you build resistance, build magic resistance.
Janna.combo: Charm Janna with Seraphine R Encore, then follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine Q High Note. Root Janna as she walks toward you and lower her health, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note, which deals more damage based on missing health. If you hit Seraphine E Beat Drop on Seraphine P Stage Presence's echo cast, the first shot's slow turns the second into a root.
Janna.escape: The chance to engage comes when Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr are down and the shield from Janna E Eye Of The Storm is gone. If Janna R Monsoon is still available, she can knock away your engage, so be ready to re-engage after she uses it or respond with Seraphine R Encore.
Janna.fight: Poke the ally Janna is protecting when they stop to last-hit, forcing Janna E Eye Of The Storm to be used.
Janna.laning: Stay near your ADC to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes, and don't walk forward alone to poke. Early on, account for the mana cost of Seraphine Q High Note and Seraphine W Surround Sound: don't spam poke, and save mana for Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound. If you bait Janna into wasting Q Howling Gale and W Zephyr, you'll have a chance to take lane control.
Janna.phase: Early on, watch for Janna E Eye Of The Storm empowering an ally and setting up a counterattack, and conserve Seraphine's mana until there's an opening to fight. Don't stand in front at any stage; fight from behind your allies.
Janna.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Seraphine W Surround Sound for a shield and movement speed, and hit grouped enemies with a penetrating Seraphine E Beat Drop to root them. If you fire Seraphine R Encore in the direction your allies are lined up in front, its range increases as it passes through them and can reach enemies behind Janna. Janna R Monsoon can knock away your engage, so look for a moment when she's isolated, and immediately use Seraphine R Encore defensively if an ally carry is caught.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale travels farther and knocks up longer the more it charges, so avoid its path if you hear it from a bush or out of vision. Don't focus damage on a target protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm; wait until the shield is gone. Janna R Monsoon knocks away an engaging ally, so save Seraphine R Encore to respond when Janna uses it.

Jhin.build: Jhin's main damage is physical and Seraphine has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Early on, buy Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Jhin.combo: Charm Jhin with Seraphine R Encore, root him with Seraphine E Beat Drop, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced. If you hit Seraphine E Beat Drop on Seraphine P Stage Presence's echo cast, the first shot's slow turns the second into a root.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage while he's reloading or after you dodge Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Use the movement speed from Seraphine W Surround Sound to go in with your allies and hit him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
Jhin.fight: Trade when Jhin is reloading or just after he fires one or two shots. Use Seraphine W Surround Sound to gain movement speed and a shield with your allies as you close the gap, then root Jhin with Seraphine E Beat Drop. If Jhin still has his final bullet, delay the engage.
Jhin.laning: Stay near your ADC to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes, and stand one step away from low-health minions so an empowered Jhin Q Dancing Grenade doesn't bounce onto you. Poke only when Jhin stops to last-hit, and save mana for Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound. If you step on Jhin E Captive Audience, move away so Jhin W Deadly Flourish can't root you there.
Jhin.phase: Early on, count Jhin's bullets and avoid the final one while Seraphine conserves mana and plays safely. Seraphine should never stand in front at any stage.
Jhin.teamfight: From the backline, use Seraphine W Surround Sound to shield your allies, and hit grouped enemies with a penetrating Seraphine E Beat Drop to root them. If you fire Seraphine R Encore in the direction your allies are lined up in front, you can extend its range to reach Jhin. If an ally carry is caught, immediately use Seraphine R Encore to turn the diver around, and dodge Jhin R Curtain Call when your health is low.
Jhin.watch: Jhin's final bullet deals heavy damage, so back off while he still has it. Right after you're hit by a Jhin basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, watch for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and move out of the straight line. If health has been reduced, focus on dodging Jhin R Curtain Call.

Jinx.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jinx's main damage is physical and Seraphine has low armor, so build armor first.
Jinx.combo: When Jinx's defensive tools are down, charm her with Seraphine R Encore, then follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine Q High Note. Root her with E as she walks toward you under the charm, then hit Q after health has been reduced. If using R is difficult, hit with E on an echo cast to link the first E's slow into a root on the second E.
Jinx.escape: The window to engage is when Jinx W Zap! misses or Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down. Jinx has no ability to create distance on her own, so coordinate with your allies' engage and catch her with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
Jinx.fight: Fight with your allies' engage after Jinx pokes with rockets or uses Jinx E Flame Chompers!. Use Seraphine E Beat Drop on a Jinx who's already slowed, or time it with an echo cast to root her. Follow up on a Jinx who's lost health with Seraphine Q High Note.
Jinx.laning: Stay near your ADC to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes, and when Jinx last-hits minions with rockets, don't stand on top of the minions. Trade only when Jinx stops to last-hit, and early on, don't spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound. Save mana for Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound.
Jinx.phase: Early on, Seraphine has a hard time getting kills alone, so poke near your allies and conserve mana. Seraphine should never stand in front, and don't start a fight right after Jinx gets a takedown or destroys a structure.
Jinx.teamfight: From the backline, use Seraphine W Surround Sound to shield your allies, and hit grouped enemies with a penetrating Seraphine E Beat Drop. Just before your allies engage, fire Seraphine R Encore through your team to extend its range and target Jinx in the backline. If an ally carry is caught, don't wait for a multi-hit; charm the diver with R.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo!'s rockets also damage enemies around the target, so don't stand right next to minions. If you're rooted by Jinx E Flame Chompers! or slowed by Jinx W Zap!, it'll be hard to create distance, so use Seraphine W Surround Sound's shield and movement speed to retreat. Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! deals more damage when health has been reduced, so don't stay within its range in that state.

Kaisa.build: Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps. Kai'Sa's main damage is physical, so build armor first. When you also need to account for the magic damage from Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, build magic resistance and health to buy time.
Kaisa.combo: After charming with Seraphine R Encore, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop, then Seraphine Q High Note. If you hit with Seraphine E Beat Drop on Seraphine P Stage Presence's Echo cast, the first hit's slow turns the second hit into a root. Quickly chain this crowd control even right after Kai'Sa enters with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to lock her down.
Kaisa.escape: At this point, chaining Seraphine E Beat Drop with Seraphine R Encore makes it hard for Kai'Sa to escape.
Kaisa.fight: Trade only when Kai'Sa stops to last-hit minions, and save Seraphine E Beat Drop to respond to Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct's dash. If Kai'Sa dives in, charm her with Seraphine R Encore, or root her with Seraphine E Beat Drop after she is slowed. Deal finishing damage with Seraphine Q High Note after Kai'Sa has lost health.
Kaisa.laning: Harass near allies so you can make use of Seraphine P Stage Presence's notes, and don't stand alone outside the wave when hit by Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. Early on, don't spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound; save mana for when you need it.
Kaisa.phase: Seraphine gets stronger in the mid to late game as she builds ability power, so fight from behind your allies and limit Kai'Sa's chances to scale through items from the early game.
Kaisa.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Seraphine W Surround Sound to grant a shield and movement speed, and save crowd control for when Kai'Sa dives in. If Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct catches an allied damage dealer, immediately charm her with Seraphine R Encore, then follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop. When attacking, aim Seraphine R Encore through allied champions to extend its range and reach the enemy backline.
Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, you can become a target for Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct. Immediately move back toward your allies until the mark disappears, and if Plasma stacks have built up, wait out the effect beyond her range. When Kai'Sa looks ready to use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stay near allied minions to spread the damage.

Kalista.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first to withstand Kalista's main physical damage. Prioritize armor for your resistances and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Kalista.combo: Charm Kalista with Seraphine R Encore, root her with Seraphine E Beat Drop, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced. If your ultimate is unavailable, use Seraphine E Beat Drop on an already slowed Kalista to root her. If you hit Seraphine E Beat Drop on Seraphine P Stage Presence's echo cast, the first shot's slow leads into a root on the second.
Kalista.escape: The window to engage is while Kalista R Fate's Call is down. Kalista P Martial Poise's jump only happens after she starts a basic attack animation, so target that moment with Seraphine E Beat Drop or charm her first with Seraphine R Encore.
Kalista.fight: Trade when Kalista starts her basic attack animation to last-hit a minion. Rather than watching her jump with Kalista P Martial Poise and throwing your spell after her, predict when the jump will begin and hit her with Seraphine E Beat Drop. Don't waste Seraphine E Beat Drop on poke; use it on your allies' engage signal or to stop Kalista from engaging.
Kalista.laning: Stay near a marksman to build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes and make the most of your basic attack range and damage. Don't spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound for early poke; trade only when Kalista stops to last-hit. When spears are stacking in you, retreat behind a bush or wall to break vision and manage your health conservatively.
Kalista.phase: Early on, watch out for Kalista's physical damage and spear stacks, and weather them with Cloth Armor. In the mid and late game, as your ability power builds, support your allies from behind, and never stand in front at any stage.
Kalista.teamfight: From the backline, use Seraphine W Surround Sound to give allies a shield and movement speed, and hit grouped enemies with a penetrating Seraphine E Beat Drop. Be ready with Seraphine E Beat Drop for the landing spot of the support Kalista throws with R Fate's Call. Just before your allies engage, fire Seraphine R Encore through them to extend its range, and immediately protect an ally carry with the charm if they're caught.
Kalista.watch: Kalista E Rend cashes in all the spears stuck in you at once, so if you've been hit by several, stop fighting and leave lane until the spears disappear. Kalista R Fate's Call can pull in her support and throw them, so watch the landing spot and spread out if the support stays close to Kalista. Armor can't block the maximum-health-based magic damage from Kalista W Sentinel.

Milio.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Milio deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If healing becomes a problem, get healing reduction earlier.
Milio.combo: If Seraphine E Beat Drop hits on Seraphine P Stage Presence's Echo turn, the first hit's slow turns the second hit into a root. If you charm them with Seraphine R Encore, follow up with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root them, then finish them with Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced.
Milio.escape: Once Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, that's your chance to close the distance. Milio has no way to create distance on his own afterward, so chain Seraphine E Beat Drop into Seraphine R Encore.
Milio.fight: Harass only when an enemy stops to last-hit, and use Seraphine Q High Note on enemies who have taken damage. Once Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, close the distance and look for a chance to lock them down with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore.
Milio.laning: Build up Seraphine P Stage Presence notes beside your marksman and harass with empowered basic attacks. Don't spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound early; aim for attrition and wave control while saving mana for when you need it.
Milio.phase: Early on, drain mana through attrition and take control of the wave before Milio's healing becomes substantial. Milio's team also gets stronger as the game goes on, so don't get ahead of your team alone in the late game; fight from behind your allies.
Milio.teamfight: From behind your allies, use Seraphine W Surround Sound to give them a shield and movement speed, and heal them as well if it's your Echo turn. Extend Seraphine R Encore's range by aiming through your allies to target the enemy backline, or immediately protect an ally carry with a charm if they're caught. If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down and you can reach Milio, lock him down with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore to cut off the enemy team's sustain.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy it hits and slows nearby enemies, so watch for it when engaging. While Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and increases the enemy marksman's range, hold off on frontline fighting.

MissFortune.build: Miss Fortune deals mainly physical damage, and Seraphine has low armor, so build armor first. Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
MissFortune.combo: If Seraphine E Beat Drop hits on Seraphine P Stage Presence's Echo turn, the first hit's slow turns the second hit into a root. If you charm them with Seraphine R Encore, follow up with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root them, then finish them with Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility, so engage when Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is down and you can approach from outside the area. Close the distance with your allies using Seraphine W Surround Sound's movement speed and shield, then catch her with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
MissFortune.fight: Trade only when Miss Fortune stops to last-hit, then back away right after she last-hits to avoid her empowered basic attack. Don't engage inside Miss Fortune E Make It Rain; catch her with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore from outside the area.
MissFortune.laning: Don't stand in a line with minions, so you can dodge Miss Fortune Q Double Up's bounce. Build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes beside your allied marksman, and save mana early so you have enough for Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound.
MissFortune.phase: Early on, respect Miss Fortune's physical damage and survive with Cloth Armor while saving Seraphine's mana for short trades. Seraphine should never stand in front at any stage.
MissFortune.teamfight: From behind, shield your allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and root grouped enemies by sending Seraphine E Beat Drop through them. Cast Seraphine R Encore through your allies in front to extend its range and reach Miss Fortune. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts or an ally carry is caught, respond with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting to hit multiple enemies.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces through minions, so don't stand right behind one; move to the side. When Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is placed, leave the slowed area instead of fighting in it. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, interrupt it with Seraphine R Encore's charm or move beside the cone.

Morgana.build: Early on, build magic resistance first with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If the enemy team has a lot of unavoidable crowd control, get Mikael's Blessing earlier. If Morgana P Soul Siphon and Morgana W Tormented Shadow make fights drag on, consider healing reduction after building resistance.
Morgana.combo: When Morgana E Black Shield is down, charm the target with Seraphine R Encore, root them with Seraphine E Beat Drop, then finish them with Seraphine Q High Note. Time Seraphine P Stage Presence's Echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first hit's slow leads into a root from the second hit.
Morgana.escape: Engage with an ally during the window when Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana E Black Shield are down. Use Seraphine W Surround Sound when you start engaging or retreating to benefit from its shield and movement speed.
Morgana.fight: Stay at a distance where you can dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding, and trade only when an enemy stops to last-hit. Once Morgana E Black Shield is down, close the distance with your allies and catch the target with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
Morgana.laning: Stay beside your marksman and move with minions between you and Morgana to dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding. Harass with Seraphine P Stage Presence notes, but save mana early so you have enough for Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound.
Morgana.phase: Early on, save Seraphine's mana and focus on dodging Morgana Q Dark Binding. Never stand in front; fight from behind your allies.
Morgana.teamfight: Protect your allies from behind with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and hit targets without Morgana E Black Shield or grouped enemies with Seraphine E Beat Drop. Just before an ally engages, cast Seraphine R Encore through your team to extend its range and reach the backline. If an ally carry is caught, don't wait for an angle to hit several enemies; charm the engaging enemy with Seraphine R Encore.
Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits you, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks will come next, so dodge it with minions between you. When low on health, don't walk over Morgana W Tormented Shadow, and if Morgana R Soul Shackles connects, get out of range before it stuns you.

Nami.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nami deals mostly magic damage, and Seraphine's magic resistance is on the low side, so prioritize magic resistance. If Nami W Ebb and Flow's healing lets them hold their ground, apply healing reduction with Morellonomicon.
Nami.combo: Before a fight, time Seraphine P Stage Presence's Echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop. If Seraphine E Beat Drop hits with Echo, the first hit's slow turns the second hit into a root. If you charm them first with Seraphine R Encore, follow up with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root them, then use Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced.
Nami.escape: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to close the distance. Nami has no mobility, so angle toward her and catch her with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore. Fight enemies affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing only after its effect ends.
Nami.fight: Trade with Nami right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. Nami has no mobility, so when you get a chance to close the distance, catch her with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore. Finish with Seraphine Q High Note after the enemy has taken damage.
Nami.laning: Build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes beside your marksman, and don't go forward alone to harass. Trade only when Nami stops to last-hit, saving mana early. After dodging Nami Q Aqua Prison, use your vision to find an angle toward Nami.
Nami.phase: Early on, keep your distance and save mana, since getting hit by Nami's crowd control once makes it easy to get hit again. Seraphine peaks in the mid to late game as her ability power builds, but never stand in front at any stage.
Nami.teamfight: From behind, shield your allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and send Seraphine E Beat Drop through grouped enemies. Just before your allies engage, cast Seraphine R Encore through your team to target the enemy backline. If an ally carry is caught, charm the engaging enemy with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting to hit multiple enemies.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns but falls slowly, so dodge to the side when you see it coming. Nami R Tidal Wave also travels slowly over a long distance, so sidestep as soon as you see it and watch for a follow-up Nami Q Aqua Prison. Avoid trading head-on with an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; fight again after it expires.

Nautilus.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nautilus deals mainly magic damage and Seraphine has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. If the enemy team has a lot of unavoidable crowd control, get Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Nautilus.combo: When Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, charm him with Seraphine R Encore, then use Seraphine E Beat Drop followed by Seraphine Q High Note. Before a fight, time Echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first hit's slow turns the second hit into a root.
Nautilus.escape: The window to engage is right after Nautilus uses Nautilus Q Dredge Line. Catch him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore, and use Seraphine W Surround Sound's movement speed and shield when backing away.
Nautilus.fight: Close the distance and trade right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. Save Seraphine E Beat Drop to respond to engages; don't use it for light harass. Finish with Seraphine Q High Note after the enemy has taken damage.
Nautilus.laning: Build notes beside your marksman and stand behind minions to block Nautilus Q Dredge Line. Trade only when an enemy stops to last-hit, and don't spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound early.
Nautilus.phase: Early on, manage your distance and mana so Nautilus can't catch you in his chain of crowd control. Never stand in front.
Nautilus.teamfight: From behind, shield your allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and respond to Nautilus when he engages with the Seraphine E Beat Drop you've saved. Seraphine R Encore's range extends if you cast it through allies in front. If an ally carry is caught, charm the engaging enemy with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting to hit multiple enemies.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and follow-up crowd control, so dodge it with minions between you. Nautilus P Staggering Blow also roots with his first basic attack, so stay out of his attack range. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don't stand on top of an ally.

Nilah.build: Nilah deals mainly physical damage and Seraphine has low armor, so buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Nilah Q Formless Blade has armor penetration, so build health as well. If healing continues through extended fights, consider healing reduction after that.
Nilah.combo: Before a fight, time Echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first hit's slow leads into a root from the second hit. If you charm Nilah with Seraphine R Encore, root her with Seraphine E Beat Drop, then use Seraphine Q High Note on Nilah after she's taken damage.
Nilah.escape: Nilah E Slipstream can be used again after a short interval, so don't engage just because she has used it. Pressure her with your allies once she has engaged and used Nilah W Jubilant Veil and you've locked her down with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
Nilah.fight: Trade briefly from outside Nilah's range only when she stops to last-hit. If Nilah closes in with Nilah E Slipstream, gain a shield and movement speed with Seraphine W Surround Sound, then stop her engage with the Seraphine E Beat Drop you've saved.
Nilah.laning: Don't spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound; save mana and Seraphine E Beat Drop to respond to Nilah's engage.
Nilah.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so several of you aren't caught by Nilah R Apotheosis, and provide them with shields and movement speed using Seraphine W Surround Sound from behind. If Nilah engages on an ally carry, charm her with Seraphine R Encore and follow up with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root her.
Nilah.watch: After Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range and area attacks are empowered, so take another step back. Save Seraphine E Beat Drop to respond when Nilah dashes in with Nilah E Slipstream, and spread out from allies while Nilah R Apotheosis is available.

Pantheon.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pantheon deals mainly physical damage, and Seraphine's armor is on the low side, so prioritize armor. Seraphine's magic damage is effective against Pantheon's low magic resistance.
Pantheon.combo: After Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends, charm him with Seraphine R Encore, follow up with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root him, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note. Time Seraphine P Stage Presence's Echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first hit's slow turns the second hit into a root. Seraphine Q High Note deals more damage to targets missing more health, so use it last.
Pantheon.escape: Don't force an engage while Pantheon W Shield Vault and Pantheon R Grand Starfall are available. Look especially for a chance before Pantheon R Grand Starfall comes back, and if Pantheon W Shield Vault is down too, lock him down with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore and fight.
Pantheon.fight: Trade briefly only when Pantheon stops to last-hit. Don't let him get in range for Pantheon W Shield Vault; if he approaches, retreat with a shield and movement speed from Seraphine W Surround Sound. Wait to attack while Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks attacks from the front, then hit him after it ends.
Pantheon.laning: Build Seraphine P Stage Presence notes beside your marksman, and take Pantheon Q Comet Spear with minions between you and Pantheon. Save mana early and keep Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound ready to respond.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's influence falls as the game goes on, while Seraphine is strong in the mid to late game as her ability power builds, so buy time and fight with your allies.
Pantheon.teamfight: From behind, shield your allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and respond when Pantheon charges in with the Seraphine E Beat Drop you've saved. If an ally carry is caught, charm Pantheon with Seraphine R Encore to send him back. When attacking, cast Seraphine R Encore through your allies to extend its range, then follow up the charm with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine Q High Note.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so back away before he can reach you. Reduce the damage from Pantheon Q Comet Spear by keeping minions between you. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.

Pyke.build: Pyke’s damage is mostly physical, and Seraphine has low armor, so use Cloth Armor to hold on early and choose Plated Steelcaps. Account for Pyke building armor penetration early and for the threshold on Pyke R Death From Below by building up your total health. If the enemy team has a lot of unavoidable crowd control, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier.
Pyke.combo: After dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow, hit Seraphine E Beat Drop on Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo cast so the first hit’s slow leads into a root on the next hit. If you charm him with Seraphine R Encore, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root him, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced. Before a major fight, you can also time the echo with Seraphine W Surround Sound to get both a shield and healing.
Pyke.escape: Don’t engage just because Pyke E Phantom Undertow is down. Engage with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore while Pyke R Death From Below is unavailable, especially when Pyke E Phantom Undertow is also down.
Pyke.fight: Stay behind your allies and keep your distance so Pyke Q Bone Skewer can’t catch you. Trade when Pyke stops to last-hit a minion. If you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, look for a chance to root him with Seraphine E Beat Drop. Once Pyke R Death From Below is down too, follow up an engage with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore.
Pyke.laning: Stay beside a marksman to stack notes from Seraphine P Stage Presence, and don’t walk forward alone to poke. Early on, don’t spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound; save enough mana for Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound to respond to Pyke’s engage. After trading, maintain vision in the direction of retreat so Pyke can’t disappear from sight and heal.
Pyke.phase: Early on, Seraphine can easily be hit by follow-up attacks once caught, so use Cloth Armor to hold on and manage your distance and mana. Seraphine peaks in the mid and late game as she builds ability power, but her health and movement speed are low, so keep staying behind your team.
Pyke.teamfight: Stay behind your team and shield allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound. Pierce clustered enemies with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root them. Cast Seraphine R Encore just before your allies engage, aiming through an ally in front to extend its range. If an allied damage dealer is caught, protect them immediately with Seraphine R Encore, and keep your distance from low-health allies so Pyke R Death From Below can’t chain.
Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you in, Pyke E Phantom Undertow can easily stun you next, so keep your distance first. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, move to the side of the direction it came from to avoid the stun. If you see a shark shadow beneath your feet, Pyke W Ghostwater Dive is nearby, so retreat toward your allies or under your turret.

Rakan.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Rakan’s damage is mostly magic, and Seraphine has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Rakan.combo: Charm Rakan with Seraphine R Encore, then follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine Q High Note, in that order. Time Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first hit’s slow turns the second hit into a root. If you throw Seraphine E Beat Drop first without setting it up, it only slows, so check whether it can be used to respond to a dash.
Rakan.escape: Right after you bait out Rakan W Grand Entrance is your window to close the distance or catch him out. When Rakan is moving alone away from his allies, he can’t dash to an ally with Rakan E Battle Dance, so look for a chance to hit him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
Rakan.fight: Trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers is stripped away. Dodge or bait out Rakan W Grand Entrance, then close the distance while holding Seraphine E Beat Drop. Use Seraphine Q High Note on Rakan after he's taken damage to get more value from its damage.
Rakan.laning: Stay beside your marksman to use Seraphine P Stage Presence’s notes and increased attack range. If Rakan W Grand Entrance catches you once, you can easily be hit by follow-up attacks, so don’t walk forward alone. Early on, don’t spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound; trade only when Rakan stops to last-hit a minion.
Rakan.phase: Early on, focus on dodging the knock-up from Rakan W Grand Entrance and keeping your distance. Don’t stand in front even then; fight from behind your allies.
Rakan.teamfight: Stay behind your team and shield allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound. If Rakan dashes in, respond with the Seraphine E Beat Drop you saved. Cast Seraphine R Encore through an ally in front to extend its range, or use it immediately to charm Rakan if an allied damage dealer is caught. Don’t stand in a line with your allies so Rakan R The Quickness can’t catch several of you at once.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance knocks you up at the landing point shown after his dash, so step to the side when Rakan starts moving. Once Rakan R The Quickness is active, it’s hard to escape on foot. Stop him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore before he reaches you, and don’t stand in a line with your allies.

Rell.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Rell’s main damage is magic, and Seraphine has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of unavoidable crowd control, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier.
Rell.combo: After Rell’s engage is down, charm her with Seraphine R Encore, then follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine Q High Note, in that order. Time Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first cast’s slow turns the second cast into a root. After Rell Q Shattering Strike is down, time the echo with Seraphine W Surround Sound if you need a shield and healing.
Rell.escape: Don’t engage just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down. Wait until Rell E Full Tilt is also down and cannot be used again, then use Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore to make it hard for Rell to escape.
Rell.fight: Poke from outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down’s range, but save Seraphine E Beat Drop to respond to her dash. If Rell charges in with Rell E Full Tilt, give up the trade and use the movement speed from Seraphine W Surround Sound to create distance. Start a fight with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore when Rell has used her mobility ability and can't escape.
Rell.laning: Stay beside your marksman to stack notes from Seraphine P Stage Presence, and keep out of reach of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Poke only when Rell stops to last-hit a minion, and use Seraphine Q High Note on Rell after she's taken damage. Early on, conserve mana and save Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound for when Rell engages.
Rell.phase: Early on, watch for Rell’s engage, keep your distance, and lower her health with magic damage. At every stage of the game, Seraphine should fight from behind her allies, never from the front.
Rell.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from your allies so Rell R Magnet Storm can’t pull several of you in at once. Stay behind your team, shield allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and root Rell with Seraphine E Beat Drop when she engages. If an allied damage dealer is caught, don’t wait for an angle to hit multiple enemies; charm Rell with Seraphine R Encore.
Rell.watch: If Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and one of her allies, take it as a sign that they are about to engage: stop trading and retreat. Stay outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down’s range, and dodge the straight-line Rell Q Shattering Strike to the side. Rell Q Shattering Strike breaks shields, so use Seraphine W Surround Sound after that ability is down.

Renata.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle to hold on early, and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Renata Glasc’s damage is mostly magic, and Seraphine has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of unavoidable crowd control, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier.
Renata.combo: After closing the distance to Renata Glasc, charm her with Seraphine R Encore, then follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine Q High Note, in that order. Root the charmed target with Seraphine E Beat Drop, then use Seraphine Q High Note after their health has been lowered to make the most of its damage based on missing health. Time Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first hit’s slow turns the second hit into a root.
Renata.escape: Renata Glasc has no mobility ability of her own, so look for a chance to close the distance when Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down. Once you’re close, lock her down with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore so she can’t escape. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your allies spread out so they don’t engage in a line.
Renata.fight: Trade damage alongside your allied marksman when Renata Glasc stops to last-hit a minion. Don’t use Seraphine E Beat Drop to poke; save it to root Renata Glasc when you close the distance or to stop the enemy’s engage. Use Seraphine W Surround Sound when starting an engage to give your allies a shield and increased movement speed.
Renata.laning: Stay beside your allied marksman and use Seraphine P Stage Presence’s notes to make the most of your attack range and damage. Early on, don’t spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound; trade only when Renata Glasc stops to last-hit a minion. Keep a minion or frontline between you and Renata Glasc to help dodge Renata Glasc Q Handshake.
Renata.phase: Early on, Renata Glasc has low health and attack damage, but Seraphine also has a hard time getting a kill alone, so pressure her with your allies. At every stage of the game, Seraphine should fight from behind her allies, never from the front.
Renata.teamfight: Stay behind your allies, give them shields and increased movement speed with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and fire Seraphine E Beat Drop through clustered enemies. Just before your allies engage, cast Seraphine R Encore through your team to find an angle that reaches enemies behind the frontline. Keep your allies spread out in case of Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover, and if an allied damage dealer is caught, use Seraphine R Encore to turn back the enemy who engaged.
Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first target it hits and throws them, which can also stun an ally, so stay behind a minion or your frontline. If you’re hit by Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover, you’ll attack nearby allies, so keep your distance from them while this ability is available.

Samira.build: Use Cloth Armor to hold on early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Samira’s main damage is physical, and Seraphine has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Samira.combo: Hit Seraphine E Beat Drop on Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo cast so the first hit’s slow turns the second hit into a root. After Samira W Blade Whirl ends, if you charm her with Seraphine R Encore, follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root her, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced.
