Samira.escape: Right after you force Samira to use Samira E Wild Rush is your window to catch her with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore. If the enemy support’s crowd control is also down, engage with less risk of Samira dashing in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse.
Samira.fight: Deal a short burst of damage only when Samira stops to last-hit a minion, and don’t let her walk into melee range. If Samira E Wild Rush is down and no one died, look for a chance to root her with Seraphine E Beat Drop. Continue your attacks after Samira W Blade Whirl ends.
Samira.laning: Stay beside your marksman and stack notes from Seraphine P Stage Presence to make the most of your range and damage. Manage the angles Samira can use to walk in, and save Seraphine E Beat Drop to respond to her dash. Early on, don’t spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound so you have mana when you need it.
Samira.phase: Early on, Seraphine can poke Samira but has a hard time getting a kill alone, so trade briefly while stopping Samira from engaging at close range. At every stage of the game, Seraphine has low health and movement speed, so don’t stand in front.
Samira.teamfight: If an allied damage dealer is caught, immediately charm the enemy with Seraphine R Encore to peel them off. When retreating, don’t leave low-health allies behind, to prevent Samira E Wild Rush from resetting repeatedly.
Samira.watch: Projectiles are destroyed while Samira W Blade Whirl is active, so attack after the spin ends. Samira can dash to you with Samira P Daredevil Impulse if you’re hit by the enemy support’s crowd control, so dodge the engage ability first. If Samira closes in and chains different types of attacks, she can follow up with R Inferno Trigger, so quickly create distance.

Senna.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Senna’s main damage is physical, and Seraphine has low armor, so build armor first.
Senna.combo: Charm Senna with Seraphine R Encore, root her with Seraphine E Beat Drop, then use Seraphine Q High Note on her after her health has been lowered. Time Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first cast’s slow turns the second cast into a root.
Senna.escape: After dodging Senna W Last Embrace, close the distance when Senna steps forward to collect a soul. Senna has no ability to create distance on her own, so catch her with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore once you’re close.
Senna.fight: Trade only when Senna steps forward to collect a soul or stops to last-hit a minion. Don’t waste Seraphine E Beat Drop on poke; use it with Seraphine R Encore when you have a chance to close the distance and root Senna.
Senna.laning: Stay beside your marksman and use Seraphine P Stage Presence’s notes; don’t walk forward alone. Watch soul locations in advance and poke as Senna approaches, but don’t spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound and run out of mana for when you need them.
Senna.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and low attack damage, so pressure her soul collection, but don’t try to get a kill alone as Seraphine. Senna’s range and attack damage keep growing if left alone, so don’t give her souls easily from the start.
Senna.teamfight: Stay behind your team and shield allies with Seraphine W Surround Sound. Pierce clustered enemies with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root them. When Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, retreat to a place with vision or use an area-of-effect ability on the mist. Use Seraphine R Encore through an ally to extend its range and reach Senna, and cast it immediately to protect an allied damage dealer if they’re caught.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness pierces allies or minions and travels in a straight line, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions, and if it hits you, move away from your allies before the root spreads. After Senna hits you once, retreat so she can’t land a second attack and collect mist.

Sivir.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Sivir’s main damage is physical, and Seraphine has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Sivir.combo: After baiting out Sivir E Spell Shield, charm her with Seraphine R Encore, then follow with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root her and finish with Seraphine Q High Note. Time Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo with Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first cast’s slow turns the second cast into a root.
Sivir.escape: Engage when Sivir E Spell Shield is down and Sivir R On The Hunt is inactive. Sivir has no blink mobility ability, so close the distance and catch her with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
Sivir.fight: Trade only when Sivir stops to last-hit a minion. Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then protect your allies and increase their movement speed with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and catch Sivir with Seraphine E Beat Drop. Use Seraphine Q High Note to finish after the enemy’s health has been lowered.
Sivir.laning: Stay beside your marksman and use Seraphine P Stage Presence’s notes. Early on, don’t spam Seraphine Q High Note or Seraphine W Surround Sound; save mana for when you need it. Since Sivir pushes the lane quickly, if you must leave someone alone in lane when you leave, push the wave beforehand or have another ally catch it.
Sivir.phase: Early on, watch out for Sivir’s fast wave clear; conserve mana as Seraphine and hold on beside your allies. The mid and late game, as she builds ability power, are strong periods for Seraphine, but still don’t stand in front.
Sivir.teamfight: Stay behind your allies, shield them with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and root Sivir with Seraphine E Beat Drop after Sivir E Spell Shield is down. Cast Seraphine R Encore through an ally in front to extend its range and look for an angle that reaches the enemy backline. Avoid long chases while Sivir R On The Hunt is active, and if an allied damage dealer is caught, protect them immediately with Seraphine R Encore.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit both on the way out and on the way back, so dodge the first hit and move out of its path on the return. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so don’t use Seraphine R Encore or Seraphine E Beat Drop first while the shield is still up. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, the whole enemy team moves faster, so avoid long chases.

Sona.build: Early on, withstand Sona’s main magic damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Seraphine has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of reliable crowd control, get Mikael’s Blessing sooner.
Sona.combo: When you have a chance to catch Sona, charm her with Seraphine R Encore, then root her with Seraphine E Beat Drop. After health has been reduced, use Seraphine Q High Note. If you time Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo cast for Seraphine E Beat Drop, the first hit’s slow turns the second hit into a root.
Sona.escape: Chasing Sona is difficult while Sona E Song of Celerity has increased her movement speed, so look for a chance to catch her after the effect ends. If you dodge Sona R Crescendo’s stun or Sona has already used it, engage on her as she steps forward with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.
Sona.fight: Look to trade when Sona steps forward to apply her aura. Sona E Song of Celerity can help her escape, so don’t rely on slows alone; catch her with Seraphine E Beat Drop’s root or Seraphine R Encore’s charm. After the enemy’s health has been reduced, finish with Seraphine Q High Note.
Sona.laning: Pressure Sona early, when she is weakest, as she pauses to last-hit or steps forward to activate her aura. Build up Seraphine P Stage Presence notes beside your marksman, and don’t spam Seraphine Q High Note and Seraphine W Surround Sound, so you have mana when you need it. Making Sona heal the damage with Sona W Aria of Perseverance can pressure her mana.
Sona.phase: Pressure Sona in lane early, before she builds up growth stacks. Sona also gets stronger as the game goes on, so don’t let fights drag out in the late game.
Sona.teamfight: Protect your allies from behind with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and send Seraphine E Beat Drop through grouped enemies. Spread out to the sides from your allies so Sona R Crescendo can’t stun you together. Use Seraphine R Encore to disrupt Sona’s position or turn back enemies engaging on your damage dealers. Have your team buy at least one Grievous Wounds item to prepare for Sona’s late-game healing.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns everyone it hits in a line, so don’t stand in a line with your allies when Sona steps forward. After Sona has used several basic abilities, if she comes within attack range, watch for Sona P Power Chord’s empowered attack or slow and create distance.

Soraka.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Soraka’s damage is mostly magic, and Seraphine has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Soraka’s healing becomes a problem in extended fights, consider Grievous Wounds next.
Soraka.combo: If you hit Soraka with Seraphine E Beat Drop on Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo cast, the first cast’s slow turns the second into a root. If you charm first with Seraphine R Encore, follow up with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root the target, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced.
Soraka.escape: The moment after Soraka E Equinox is down is your chance to close the gap. Soraka has no mobility ability, so catch her then with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore. If Soraka E Equinox’s zone is still there, use your engage ability before stepping into it.
Soraka.fight: Once you see Soraka use Soraka E Equinox first, that’s your chance to engage. Avoid Soraka Q Starcall while pressuring the enemy marksman and making Soraka use Soraka W Astral Infusion; this also costs Soraka health. When you have a chance to catch Soraka, deal your damage in a short burst.
Soraka.laning: Harass from beside your marksman, using Seraphine P Stage Presence notes. Trade when the enemy stops to last-hit, and dodge Soraka Q Starcall. Early on, don’t spam Seraphine Q High Note and Seraphine W Surround Sound, so you have mana when you need it.
Soraka.phase: Early on, Seraphine should conserve mana, build magic resistance, and harass alongside her marksman. Seraphine has low health and movement speed at every stage, so don’t stand in front.
Soraka.teamfight: Protect your allies from behind with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and root grouped enemies by sending Seraphine E Beat Drop through them. If you cast Seraphine R Encore through your allies as they line up in front, its range extends with each ally hit, letting you reach the enemy backline. Rather than continually hitting enemies Soraka is healing, root Soraka and focus her. If an enemy engages on your damage dealers, protect them immediately with Seraphine R Encore.
Soraka.watch: Avoid Soraka Q Starcall: if it hits you, Soraka heals and gains movement speed while you’re slowed. Soraka E Equinox’s zone silences you and can also root you, so use your engage ability before stepping into it. Soraka R Wish heals her allies, which can make you miss your chance to finish them in trades that chip away at their health.

Taric.build: Early on, withstand his damage with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Taric’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of reliable crowd control, get Mikael’s Blessing sooner.
Taric.combo: Before a fight, time Seraphine P Stage Presence’s echo cast for Seraphine E Beat Drop so the first hit’s slow turns the second into a root. If you charm with Seraphine R Encore, follow up with Seraphine E Beat Drop to root the target, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced.
Taric.escape: The moment after Taric E Dazzle misses is your chance to engage. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you have a chance to catch him, lock him down with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.

Cast Seraphine R Encore through your allies just before they engage, or use it immediately to protect your damage dealers when they’re caught. Stop dealing damage while Taric R Cosmic Radiance makes enemies invulnerable; pin them down with Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine R Encore, then attack again when the invulnerability ends.

If Thresh engages first, use Seraphine W Surround Sound as you begin to retreat to make use of its movement speed and shield.

After dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence sideways, close the gap, but check that Thresh W Dark Passage is also down before rooting him with Seraphine E Beat Drop. Use Seraphine Q High Note after the enemy’s health has been reduced to take advantage of its damage based on missing health.

Save Seraphine E Beat Drop to stop Thresh’s engage rather than using it to harass.

Thresh.teamfight: Protect your allies from behind with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and root Thresh as he engages or grouped enemies by sending Seraphine E Beat Drop through them. Seraphine R Encore can pass through allies in front to extend its range; if an enemy catches your damage dealers, charm them immediately to turn them back. When Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, either finish off the target immediately or retreat. If you’re trapped in Thresh R The Box, decide right away which wall to break through.

Move sideways when Thresh raises his hook, and change direction again when stepping up to last-hit. Avoid the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay can’t pull you toward them.

Use Seraphine P Stage Presence notes beside your marksman, conserve mana, and focus on positioning and vision.

If you cast Seraphine R Encore through your allies as they line up in front, its increased range can reach Tristana. If Tristana engages on your damage dealers, charm her immediately with R. If an ally goes down and your team is losing the fight, retreat right away.

Don’t engage recklessly while both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are ready. In teamfights, Tristana’s W resets when she gets a takedown, so retreat as soon as an ally goes down.

When Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals his position, coordinate with your allies to catch him with Seraphine R Encore or Seraphine E Beat Drop. Don’t stay in Twitch W Venom Cask to deal more damage; use the shield and movement speed from Seraphine W Surround Sound to get out.

Alert your allies when Twitch leaves lane, and check paths without vision with a Control Ward before crossing.

If an allied damage dealer is caught, charm Twitch with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting for an angle that hits multiple enemies.

Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap safely, then catch him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore.

Send Seraphine E Beat Drop through grouped enemies, and cast Seraphine R Encore through your allies to extend its range toward the enemy backline. If Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, spread out from them so the root doesn’t spread.

If you’ve taken several basic attacks, back off and give the stacks time to expire. Varus E Hail of Arrows reduces healing, so step out of the area before using Seraphine W Surround Sound’s heal. If allies are caught by Varus R Chain of Corruption, create enough distance that the tendrils can’t reach you.

Save early mana for Seraphine E Beat Drop and Seraphine W Surround Sound when needed.

Look for an opening after Yasuo launches his whirlwind and Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s stacks reset, and save Seraphine E Beat Drop to respond to his engage. When Yasuo W Wind Wall appears, move to an angle that goes around it or save your key abilities until it disappears.

If you cast Seraphine R Encore in the direction your allies are lined up in front, it extends each time it hits an ally and can reach the enemy backline. If Yasuo catches an allied damage dealer, charm him immediately with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting for an angle that hits multiple enemies.

Just before your allies engage, cast Seraphine R Encore through an ally in front to extend its range and reach Zeri’s backline. If Zeri engages and catches an allied damage dealer, send her back immediately with Seraphine R Encore instead of waiting to hit multiple enemies.

If Seraphine R Encore charms Zilean, follow up with Seraphine E Beat Drop to immobilize him, then finish with Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced. In teamfights with an ally in front, cast Seraphine R Encore through them to extend its range.
Zilean.escape: Dodging Zilean Q Time Bomb's second bomb or waiting until Zilean E Time Warp is down is your chance to close the distance. Zilean has no mobility spell, so approach with an ally and catch him with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore. When engaging, split directions with your allies so Zilean E Time Warp can't stop everyone at once.
Zilean.fight: Trade damage with your allied ranged carry when Zilean stops to last-hit a minion. When you've dodged two Zilean Q Time Bombs or Zilean E Time Warp is down, close the distance with your ally and catch him with Seraphine E Beat Drop. Use Seraphine Q High Note after chipping away at his health to make the most of its missing-health damage.
Zilean.laning: Conserve mana early so you can use Seraphine W Surround Sound and Seraphine E Beat Drop when needed.
Zilean.teamfight: Use Seraphine W Surround Sound from behind to shield allies, and send Seraphine E Beat Drop through clustered enemies. Cast Seraphine R Encore just before your allies engage to stop the enemy from responding; use it immediately to protect an allied carry if they're caught. Don't spend your abilities on a target with Zilean R Chronoshift while they're waiting to revive. If you can't wait, target them just after they revive, or switch to the squishy Zilean himself.
Zilean.watch: Zilean Q Time Bomb stuns when two bombs attach to the same target. When the first bomb attaches, move away from allies and out of its blast radius, using Seraphine W Surround Sound's movement speed boost and shield to escape. If Zilean E Time Warp slows you, the next bomb will be harder to dodge, so don't stand alone in front.

Zyra.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zyra's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance.
Zyra.combo: If Seraphine R Encore charms Zyra, follow up with Seraphine E Beat Drop to immobilize her, then use Seraphine Q High Note after health has been reduced. If you land Seraphine E Beat Drop on Seraphine P Stage Presence's Echo, the first hit's slow turns the second hit into a root.
Zyra.escape: Dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots sideways to draw it out, then close the distance. Zyra has no ability to create distance on her own, so catch her then with Seraphine E Beat Drop or Seraphine R Encore. Seraphine also has no ability to escape on her own, so don't move ahead while Zyra's root is still available.
Zyra.fight: Fight with an ally after Zyra E Grasping Roots misses, when there are no plants nearby. Time Seraphine E Beat Drop with Echo to follow up with a root, and use Seraphine Q High Note on Zyra after her health is chipped away.
Zyra.laning: Stay by your ranged carry to stack Seraphine P Stage Presence's Notes, and don't walk forward alone. Only trade when Zyra stops to last-hit a minion, to conserve mana. Step on seeds to destroy them as you pass, but if Zyra tries to grow them with an ability, back away, then step on them again.
Zyra.phase: Early on, Seraphine should watch out for Zyra's root and plant damage while managing distance and mana. Don't stand in front at any point in the game.
Zyra.teamfight: Avoid fighting where Zyra has built up seeds and plants, and move the fight elsewhere. Protect allies from behind with Seraphine W Surround Sound, and send Seraphine E Beat Drop through clustered enemies. Aim Seraphine R Encore at Zyra and the backline from an angle that passes through an ally in front; if an allied carry is caught, use it immediately to protect them with a charm.
Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots roots you, it's easy to get hit by Zyra's plant damage and Zyra R Stranglethorns as well. Move sideways at the edge of its range to dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots. When you see Zyra R Stranglethorns' cast indicator, use Seraphine W Surround Sound's movement speed to walk out of the area. Don't fight where Zyra's plants are clustered.
